name: Suno
summary: Create full songs with vocals from a text prompt.
description: Suno generates complete songs with vocals, lyrics and instrumentation from a text prompt, with editing tools to extend and rework tracks. It is one of the most popular AI music generators. The Free plan ($0) gives 50 credits per day on the free model (v6-mini); Pro costs $8/month and Premier $24/month billed yearly, adding the best models and commercial use.
